description: Submit tx_hash after paying an invoice. Supports XRPL, Xahau, Base (0x… hash), and Solana. Returns a signed JWT access_token (1-hour TTL). For a Xahau invoice with fee_required=true, also submit fee_tx_hash (the 0.01 XAH facilitator-fee payment) — settlement requires both payments. Free.

fee_tx_hash.description: Xahau only, when the invoice has fee_required=true: tx hash of the 0.01 XAH facilitator-fee payment to fee_pay_to carrying fee_memo_hex

tx_hash.description: XRPL/Xahau: 64-char hex; Base: 0x-prefixed hex; Solana: base58 signature

name: verify_payment
